noise_index_db.source: provisional: model knowledge (the ranges usually quoted from Motchenbacher & Connelly, Low-Noise Electronic System Design, Wiley 1993, resistor excess noise: carbon composition 0.1-3 uV/V per decade (-20..+10 dB), carbon film 0.05-0.3, metal film 0.02-0.2, wirewound 0.01-0.2; to be checked against the book. The definition: IEC 60195 / MIL-STD-202 Method 308, web: https://epci.eu/resistors-noise-and-corrosion/ (rms uV per V of DC per decade, measured around 1 kHz; grows with the resistance value; carbon composition and thick film the worst, metal film and wirewound negligible))

tube_12ax7_idle.title: a 12AX7 at idle, grid-referred: shot + flicker (B5's model)

gm_s.source: RCA 12AX7 sheet: gm 1600 umho at 250 V, -2 V (B5's corner figure)

flicker_v2.source: provisional: model knowledge (estimate, device builder B5: space-charge-limited, a relative emission fluctuation dJ/J moves the potential minimum by (kTc/q) dJ/J, a grid-referred voltage independent of the operating point, K_f = (kTc/q)^2 A with kTc/q ~0.09 V (1050 K) and A ~3e-12, the order of oxide cathodes' emission flicker in temperature-limited diodes (Johnson 1925, Schottky 1926); a corner ~1 kHz for a 12AX7 at gm 1.6 mA/V, the user's pick 2026-10-30; bounds 2.5e-15..2.5e-13, corners 100 Hz..10 kHz)

shot_beta.source: K. R. Spangenberg, Vacuum Tubes (McGraw-Hill, 1948), noise: R_eq = 2.5 / gm for a triode, (Ip / Ik)(2.5 / gm)(1 + 8 I2 / gm) for a pentode (after Thompson, North & Harris, RCA Review 1940-41); web: https://n5296s.blogspot.com/2025/09/tubes-201-how-vacuum-tubes-really-work_90.html (the same forms)

kappa_per_s.source: provisional: model knowledge (kappa: avalanche durations up to ~1 ms in soft FeSi / NiFe cores, a cutoff near 1 kHz; c_per_ms: a sweep through the loop in ~1 s crackles (c ~0.1-1, the review's quasi-static experiments), so c per unit rate (saturation magnetizations per second) ~0.25 s; nothing fitted)

model.source: ABBM model, web: https://arxiv.org/abs/cond-mat/0404512 (Durin & Zapperi, The Barkhausen effect: the velocity's square-root diffusion; avalanches power-law distributed in the intermittent regime c < 1, a Lorentzian-like spectrum cut off by the demagnetizing factor)
